mapper.sql: id, title, description, price, category, seller, contact, status, created_at, updated_at

where.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item (title, description, price, category, seller, contact, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{category}, #{seller}, #{contact}, COALESCE(#{status}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, category = #{category}, seller = #{seller}, contact = #{contact}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
